signature: SUBROUTINE DLARRJ( N, D, E2, IFIRST, ILAST,

params.name: d
params.reference: The N diagonal elements of T.

params.name: E2
params.reference: The Squares of the (N-1) subdiagonal elements of T.

params.name: ifirst
params.reference: The index of the first eigenvalue to be computed.

params.name: ilast
params.reference: The index of the last eigenvalue to be computed.

params.name: rtol
params.reference: Tolerance for the convergence of the bisection intervals. An interval \[LEFT,RIGHT\] has converged if $\mathrm{RIGHT}-\mathrm{LEFT} < \mathrm{RTOL} \, \max (|\mathrm{LEFT}|,|\mathrm{RIGHT}|)$.

params.name: offset
params.reference: Offset for the arrays W and `WERR`, i.e., the `IFIRST`-`OFFSET` through `ILAST`-`OFFSET` elements of these arrays are to be used.

params.name: w
params.reference: On input, W( `IFIRST`-`OFFSET` ) through W( `ILAST`-`OFFSET` ) are estimates of the eigenvalues of L D L^T indexed `IFIRST` through `ILAST`. On output, these estimates are refined.

params.name: WERR
params.reference: On input, WERR( `IFIRST`-`OFFSET` ) through WERR( `ILAST`-`OFFSET` ) are the errors in the estimates of the corresponding elements in W. On output, these errors are refined.

params.name: pivmin
params.reference: The minimum pivot in the Sturm sequence for T.
